jobInfo.jobDescription:
School nurse substitutes sought--all schools--to work in health offices as well as provide nursing coverage on field trips. School nursing experience preferred, but not required. Per Diem Pay: $200.00 Substitute hiring is ongoing throughout the school year. Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51. Information regarding CORI and SAFIS background checks can be obtained by contacting any of the school administrative secretaries or Liz Petersen, Administrative Secretary to the Superintendent of Schools.

Lunenburg Middle/High School 1079 Massachusetts Avenue Lunenburg, MA 01462 978.582.4115
Turkey Hill Elementary School 129 Northfield Road, Lunenburg, MA 01462 978.582.4110
Lunenburg Primary School 1401 Massachusetts Avenue, Lunenburg, MA 01462 978.582.4122
Office of the Superintendent 129 Northfield Road, Lunenburg, MA 01462 978.582.4100, Extension 5211
jobInfo.requirements:
CPR certification and license to practice nursing in Massachusetts required.
